title: Dîner après le théâtre  (Dinner After the Theatre)

segments.t: Following his brilliant theatrical performance, acclaimed actor Fabrice Luchini meets Andréa Martel for a late dinner. The pair exchange warm compliments and playful relationship advice in high spirits before their evening is interrupted. Listen to the scene in French first. Don't worry about catching every word.
Bonsoir Andréa! Tu es très élégante.
Merci Fabrice. Bravo pour ton spectacle!
C'était vraiment une pièce magnifique.
Tu as aimé ma prestation?
J'ai absolument adoré ton jeu.
Et cette jeune femme blonde d'hier?
Non, ce n'est pas mon genre.
Elle te plaît beaucoup. Fonce!
Tu crois vraiment que ça marcherait?
C'est tout à fait évident!
Je ne sais pas par où commencer.
Fais-moi confiance pour l'amour.
On mange quelque chose maintenant?
Oui, commandons un bon dîner.
Now let's break down the scene step by step. Listen to each line, followed by its meaning and a short explanation.
Bonsoir Andréa! Tu es très élégante.
'Good evening Andréa! You look very elegant.' Fabrice greets Andrea warmly as they meet at the restaurant table.
Merci Fabrice. Bravo pour ton spectacle!
'Thank you Fabrice. Bravo on your show!' She immediately congratulates him on his stage performance.
C'était vraiment une pièce magnifique.
'It was truly a magnificent play.' Andrea highlights the beauty and depth of the production.
Tu as aimé ma prestation?
'Did you like my performance?' The actor seeks her candid artistic reaction.
J'ai absolument adoré ton jeu.
'I absolutely loved your acting.' She expresses unbounded admiration for his theatrical craft.
Et cette jeune femme blonde d'hier?
'And that young blonde woman from yesterday?' Fabrice turns the conversation to her romantic life.
Non, ce n'est pas mon genre.
'No, she is not my type.' Andrea brushes off the inquiry with a casual denial.
Elle te plaît beaucoup. Fonce!
'You like her very much. Go for it!' The actor playfully encourages her to take a bold chance on romance.
Tu crois vraiment que ça marcherait?
'Do you really think that would work?' She questions whether taking such an initiative is wise.
C'est tout à fait évident!
'It is completely obvious!' Fabrice insists that the romantic connection is undeniable.
Je ne sais pas par où commencer.
'I do not know where to start.' Andrea admits feeling completely at a loss with dating.
Fais-moi confiance pour l'amour.
'Trust me when it comes to love.' He poses as an experienced philosopher of romantic relationships.
On mange quelque chose maintenant?
'Shall we eat something now?' He suggests turning their attention to ordering food.
Oui, commandons un bon dîner.
'Yes, let us order a good dinner.' Andrea agrees happily to start their meal. Now let's listen to the entire exchange once more from beginning to end.

Merci Fabrice. Bravo pour ton spectacle!

Fais-moi confiance pour l'amour.

Oui, commandons un bon dîner.
Fabrice Luchini and Andréa bond over theatrical art and romantic advice over dinner. Remember the colloquial French encouragement for seizing an opportunity: fonce. See you next time!
À demain!
